blocks.label: Blocks

items.label: Items
items.description: One entry per vanilla item class with behaviour, plus one per behaviour component (food, tool, equippable, ...) for items that have no class of their own.

commands.label: Commands

redstone.label: Redstone

pex-plugins.label: PEX plugins

performance.label: Performance

storage.label: Storage

ops.label: Ops
